notes: Samsung's spec table prints Folded/Unfolded as WIDTH x HEIGHT x DEPTH -- the second value is identical folded and unfolded (the hinge-axis dimension), so it is mapped to `height` and the first value to `width`. The ONLY Galaxy Z Fold generation where Samsung explicitly describes the crease shape: 'an enhanced water droplet design' for the Armor FlexHinge -> crease = teardrop. Folded thickness footnote: 'measured from top to bottom of the glasses'; unfolded thickness footnote: 'does not include the frame of the Main Screen' -- so open.depth 4.2mm is the panel-area thickness, not the frame thickness. Single folded thickness -> depth_at_hinge null. free_stop: this press release never mentions Flex Mode -> null rather than assumed. Inner-screen aspect ratio is not printed in the spec table -> null. RESOLUTION ORDERING: recorded verbatim as Samsung prints it. Samsung is NOT consistent across generations -- the 2025 Z Fold7 table prints '(2184 x 1968)' and '(2520 x 1080, 21:9)' (long axis first) while the 2026 Z Fold8 / Fold8 Ultra table prints '(1,848 x 2,448)', '(1,248 x 1,972)' and '(1,080 x 2,520)' (short axis first).
